learner_profile.evidence_policy: Do not assume a learner knows a concept merely because it appears in a lesson.

rules: Quiz results are useful but not proof of independent coding mastery.
Viewing a source line changes no GitHub state automatically.
After the learner exports an attempt, check the evidence and update this file and source-lines.json deliberately.
Future lessons should build on demonstrated concepts and use brief revision only where needed.
Keep the original project code unchanged by placing learning materials under learning/.
sync_instructions: Open learning/lessons/01-first-python/index.html, complete the lesson, download the attempt JSON, and share the file with ChatGPT. It can then record your demonstrated learning in GitHub.
